validator: independent validator subagent (claude-opus-5-5), 2026-11-11; code in the validator scratchpad (copied to validation/scripts/), not the producer's

pristine_source_build.toolchain: rustc 1.97.0 / cargo 1.97.0; rand 0.8.8, rand_chacha 0.3.1, rand_core 0.6.4, serde_json 1.0.151 (arbitrary_precision, raw_value); Python 3, numpy

replay.note: the 528 v2 ic4/bsgs2 rows (v2 binary bbcc68cc) replay exactly with the fixed source: their code is unchanged
replay.fields_compared: every field the binary emits except ms: arm, n, p, targets, seed, param, ok, I, M, S, H, L, every phase snapshot, every arm extra

scalar_verification.method: instrumented build dumps (t, planted x_t, recovered log, Q_t); validator Python (projective Montgomery ladder, Fermat inversion; nothing shared with the harness) checks Q_t on the curve, 0 <= log < n, log == planted x_t, [log]G == Q_t; planted lists identical across arms of a configuration
scalar_verification.sample_rule: per (arm, bits, T) one run, drawn with random.Random('v3val:' + nonce)
scalar_verification.negative_control: shared with Study A (same binary and checker)
scalar_verification.remaining_runs: ok == targets from the binary's own counted check, reproduced exactly by replay; not independently re-derived

runs_fields: sha256[:16] of the replayed output without ms
replayed by: i = instrumented source build (all rows), p = pristine source build (nonce sample), b = producer binary (nonce sample)
scalar: v:<ok>/<targets> independently verified by the validator's EC code, c:<ok>/<targets> the replayed binary's counted check
